actions.action: Bind callouts to explicit evidence tests
actions.mechanism: Reevaluate the cited comparison after refresh instead of treating annotation text as permanently valid.
actions.implementation: Store metric IDs, filter IDs, date bounds, comparison type, and analyst-set tolerance per annotation. Route unsupported claims to manual review.
actions.check: Reverse two series’ rankings; the ranking callout must become contradicted. Shift date bounds; require scope review.
actions.risk: Passing a comparison cannot validate causal wording.

actions.action: Represent unavailable evidence separately from zero
actions.mechanism: Explicit availability states prevent missing series or observations from silently satisfying numeric comparisons.
actions.implementation: Distinguish observed zero, missing observation, and absent series. Record required coverage for each evidence test; mark insufficient coverage indeterminate.
actions.check: Refresh with zero, null, and an omitted series separately; confirm distinct displays and indeterminate results for insufficient evidence.
actions.risk: Aggregation defaults may still conceal missing observations.

actions.action: Show evidence changes in a review inbox
actions.mechanism: Separate changed inputs from changed conclusions so harmless revisions remain visible without implying contradiction.
actions.implementation: Compare each annotation’s reviewed evidence with refreshed evidence. Show before/after values, scope differences, and test status; retain unresolved changes across refreshes.
actions.check: Revise history within the configured tolerance; show changed evidence with an unchanged conclusion before export, not a contradiction.
actions.risk: Broad tolerances can conceal meaningful changes; display them.

actions.action: Export only a reviewed, version-pinned snapshot
actions.mechanism: An atomic export gate prevents refreshes from invalidating annotations between review and file generation.
actions.implementation: Pin data and annotation versions during export. Require acknowledgment of changes; exclude or visibly qualify unresolved callouts. Embed version, metric, filter, and date metadata.
actions.check: Trigger refresh during export; verify the artifact contains one coherent reviewed version and identifiable provenance, never mixed snapshots.
actions.risk: Version identifiers alone cannot reconstruct discarded historical data.
